name: Bitter & Sweet
source:
Welcome to Roses! You've recently been offered a position as the closing shift barista at a niche little Mom and Mom's coffee shop right across the street from your college campus. It's not your top choice, naturally. But... you also need the money.

Thankfully, you've had many different jobs in your life so far. So you've survived many "first weeks of employment." This one should be no different.

You're not here to make friends, after all.

You're not here to make friends.

You're not here to...

translation:
欢迎来到玫瑰！最近，你在大学校园对面的一家小众妈妈和妈妈咖啡店获得了一份倒班咖啡师的职位。当然，这不是你的最佳选择。但是……你还需要钱。

值得庆幸的是，到目前为止，你一生中已经从事过许多不同的工作。所以你已经度过了许多“就业的第一周”。这个应该没有什么不同。

毕竟，你来这里不是为了交朋友的。

你来这里不是为了…
